items.name: Macbook M3 Pro
items.description: This is the laptop I use. It runs my game extremely well with 60+ GB of cc. My loading time is like maybe 2 minutes from launch to main menu.

items.name: Blender
items.description: I use Blender 5.1.2 for all mesh editing. This includes essentially all of my conversions and new meshes.

items.name: Sims 4 Studio
items.description: I use the latest version of S4S Aurora. This is how I create the package files as well as add the converted meshes or recolors etc.

items.name: Photoshop 2025
items.description: This is used for texture editing mainly. It's not usually necessary for conversions but if needed you can use Photopea for free (check next entry). I do NOT recommend buying Photoshop just for conversions.

items.name: Photopea
items.description: This is basically just photoshop as a free website. It's a great alternative, but you could also use gimp or any other photo editing software.

items.name: S4CasTools
items.description: I use this to clone hairs or accessories I convert. It also has a bunch of QoL tools. You don't need this to clone cc but its the easiest way. It's a windows only program. Since I'm on mac, I use crossovers to run it.
